searchText: <@!755590043632140352> looks very different now 🙂 * adding line chart to track historical performance * "TOTAL" row (will not be able to include att. eff and streak though (query will blow up)) I am shocked by some of those numbers, there's whale-15 that has 209 validators that haven't missed a single attestation in 83 days, I find that highly unlikely, As for the total row: I trully don't really care about att. eff. and also streak I find kind of irrelevant. The one indicator that ultimately matters is rewards/#attestations.
